## LogMode {#Sisk_Core_Http_HttpContext_LogMode}

Gets or sets an [LogOutput](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Routing.LogOutput.md) mode for this context, which will overwrite the
matched route log mode option.

```csharp
public LogOutput? LogMode { get; set; }
```
